author: SUPUZZ Editorial Team
title: Before you give building blocks: a five-point family checklist
description: Choose a building toy gift around the child and family: check age guidance, interests, play space, storage and the actual set contents.
imageAlt: A colorful amusement park built with SUPUZZ waffle blocks

hero.caption: Give the time to create. The photo shows an example build.

intro: A good building gift fits everyday life as well as the moment the box opens. Look beyond box size and piece count to the child’s interests and the family’s space.

checklist.title: Five things to check before ordering
paragraphs: If possible, ask a parent or caregiver about these points.
items: Age guidance: does the actual product match the child and its instructions?
Interests: does it connect with favorite vehicles, animals or color play?
Play space: is there room to spread out and build?
Storage: is a case included, and is there somewhere to keep it?
Contents: can you distinguish example photos from the pieces and accessories included?

storage.title: Cleanup is part of the gift
paragraphs: A place to gather the pieces makes the next play session easier to start. Check the case and storage space; packaging differs between products and versions.

image.alt: Crane and vehicle creations built from waffle blocks
image.caption: Use examples to imagine the recipient’s favorite kind of play.

give.title: Add an invitation to build together
paragraphs: Let’s build a home for your car. A simple invitation can be more useful than a perfect first model. Sit alongside the child and leave room for their idea.

versions.title: A level name is not an age label
paragraphs: L1, L2 and L3 identify versions. Contents and age guidance differ across collections, so check the selected product rather than applying one age chart to every set.

group.title: Plan seasonal and group gifts early
paragraphs: Share your quantity, budget and preferred timing when asking about a group order. Confirm current price, stock and delivery when buying. Gift orders do not automatically receive an education discount.

items.question: Can I give blocks for a second birthday?
items.answer: Check the specific product’s age guidance and pieces. Products from one brand can have different age recommendations.

items.question: Is the set with the most pieces always best?
items.answer: No. Consider the theme, play space and cleanup as well as the number of pieces.
